latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Transcript Generator — Convert Video Speech to Text.

- Instantly generate accurate text transcripts from uploaded video or audio files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Simple workflow: upload, describe your request, and receive downloadable transcript files in 30–90 seconds.
- Seamless automatic authentication and session creation.
- Supports common export and status actions, with clear error messaging.
- Designed for content creators, journalists, and students needing fast, reliable transcriptions.
